cards.translation: 那座古老的庄园俯瞰着幽暗的湖面

cards.translation: 解剖室位于控制局站点的深处

cards.translation: 她正对着一排图表皱眉怒视，房间突然变红了

cards.translation: 朱尔斯曾为"舆论观感"抱怨个不停。黛安娜没理他

cards.translation: 此刻，在她那间位于 cauldron lake 水位线之下的办公室里，她思索着下一步该怎么走

cards.translation: 沃林·多尔走过卡尔德拉街广场被雨水打滑的瓷砖

cards.text: So hard his whole body and soul felt twisted and mangled

cards.text: The hidden device they had hooked to the FBC station had been intercepting alarms like crazy the past few days
cards.translation: 他们偷偷接在控制局站点上的隐藏装置，这几天疯狂地截获警报

cards.text: Out in the night, the story seeking to give birth to an overlap in watery drifted on, looking for another pair of men more prone to corruption
cards.translation: 夜幕下，那个想在 watery 孕育异界重叠的故事继续游荡，寻找另一对更容易堕落的人

cards.text: A hush so profound, it rang like a scream
cards.translation: 一片深不见底的寂静，响得像一声尖叫

cards.text: Something of impossible scale loomed over it, blocking the sky. took a hold of the rim of the crater
cards.translation: 一个大得超乎想象的东西笼罩其上，遮住了天空。它抓住了弹坑的边缘

cards.text: The water sloshed. swirled inside like a vortex
cards.translation: 水在晃荡，在里面打着旋，像一个漩涡

cards.text: Drugging lane made him more compliant, but his work had turned abstract
cards.translation: 给莱恩下药让他更顺从了，但他的作品变得抽象晦涩

cards.text: Jules needed more art his team could parse
cards.translation: 朱尔斯需要更多他的团队能解析的艺术

cards.text: His grip tightened around the letter opener in his hand
cards.translation: 他手中拆信刀的握柄越攥越紧

cards.text: When the government seized the land around cauldron lake and set up their laboratory there, ilmo koskela knew they knew something. together with his brother, they felt obliged to take a look inside
cards.translation: 当政府征占 cauldron lake 周边的土地建起实验室时，伊尔莫·科斯凯拉就知道他们知道些什么。他和哥哥觉得有义务进去看个究竟

cards.text: His skull will become the crown of the grandmaster
cards.translation: 他的头骨将成为宗师的冠冕

cards.text: After the service, ilmo had the body hauled off to be turned into moose steaks. mulligan and thornton were told to get the head cleaned. they both grabbed an antler
cards.translation: 葬礼之后，伊尔莫让人把尸体拖去做成驼鹿排，让马利根和桑顿去把鹿头清理干净。两人一人抓了一只鹿角

cards.text: They grumbled. wanted to just get it fucking done
cards.translation: 他们嘟囔着发牢骚，只想赶紧把活干完

cards.text: The writer went into the lake. banished the dark presence. Taken still lurked in the woods. The dark place receded
cards.translation: 作家走进了湖里，驱逐了黑暗存在。被夺者仍在林中潜伏，黑暗之地则退去了

cards.text: Wandering in the shadows. muttering to themselves
cards.translation: 在阴影中游荡，自顾自地喃喃低语

cards.text: Premium cabins for rent in bright falls
cards.translation: bright falls 有高档小屋出租

cards.text: Next stop, caldera street station. something, a presence, rumbled. not a train
cards.translation: 下一站，卡尔德拉街站。有什么东西、一个存在，在轰鸣。不是火车

cards.text: A face-off between deities on the rim of cauldron lake, high above its dark waters
cards.translation: 神灵们在 cauldron lake 湖畔之巅对峙，脚下是幽暗的湖水

cards.text: Or, changing the perspective, raging lunatics all, caught up in the frenzy of a shared delusion
cards.translation: 或者换个角度看，不过是一群暴怒的疯子，陷入共同妄想的狂热

cards.text: The old gods, the corsairs of the sea of night, and the dark one who yearned to stand in-between, who had always stood in-between, who would soon stand in-between
cards.translation: 古神们，黑夜之海上的海盗，还有那个渴望站在两者之间、一直站在两者之间、很快就要站在两者之间的黑暗之主

cards.text: "we help you, you stay away from our family," Tor Anderson snarled over the thunder
cards.translation: "我们帮你，你离我们家远点，"托尔·安德森在雷声中咆哮

cards.text: "i will take this as collateral so you'll remember our deal," said the dark one
cards.translation: "我要拿走这个当抵押，好让你们记住我们的交易，"黑暗之主说

cards.text: Blood arched from odin's face as he fell to his knees
cards.translation: 奥丁跪倒在地，血从他脸上呈弧线喷溅而出

cards.text: Effectively blind in that moment, the eyepatch covering his left eye, his hand over the now empty socket of his right, blood oozing out of it, odin cursed
cards.translation: 那一刻奥丁近乎全盲：左眼蒙着眼罩，右手捂住右眼此刻空空的眼窝，血正从中渗出。他咒骂道

cards.text: Odin anderson stirred in his bed
cards.translation: 奥丁·安德森在床上动了动身子

cards.text: His vision was hazy, smudged
cards.translation: 他的视线模糊不清，像被涂污了

cards.text: Some of them would chastise the others for acting out. it was like herding a clowder of cats
cards.translation: 他们中有人会训诫那些闹腾的家伙。这简直像放牧一大群猫

cards.text: Ahti was wearing blum's coveralls again
cards.translation: 阿赫蒂又穿上了布卢姆的连体工作服

cards.text: The time drew nigh
cards.translation: 时刻临近了

cards.text: Rose frowned
cards.translation: 萝丝皱起了眉

cards.text: Something about knitwear... that the hero... liked it?
cards.translation: 关于针织衫的什么……那位英雄……喜欢这个？

cards.text: She'd use knitwork to guide the hero to the secret stashes she had hid in the forest to help them
cards.translation: 她会用针织花样引导那位英雄找到她藏在森林里的秘密物资，好帮他们一把

cards.text: A man in a white coat came to steer lane back to his cell
cards.translation: 一个白大褂男人过来把莱恩押回牢房

cards.text: He lay on the bed, but the stench in his cell wouldn't let him sleep. an acid stink
cards.translation: 他躺在床上，可牢房里的恶臭让他无法入睡。一股刺鼻的酸臭

cards.text: A putrid weight he could never wash away
cards.translation: 一种腐烂的沉重，他永远洗不掉

cards.text: Cold hate simmered below the mist clogging his thoughts
cards.translation: 冰冷的恨意在堵塞他思绪的迷雾之下暗涌

cards.text: The mutilated corpse laying on the rain-soaked wood
cards.translation: 被肢解的尸体躺在被雨水浸透的木板上

cards.text: Saga edged toward the broken door. her gun ready. flashlight aimed ahead
cards.translation: 萨加缓缓挪向破损的门，枪已上膛，手电照向前方

cards.text: The cauldron lake general store was overgrown. left to rot
cards.translation: cauldron lake 的杂货店早已杂草丛生，任其腐烂

cards.text: Planning a gruesome ritual murder
cards.translation: 策划一起骇人的仪式性谋杀

cards.text: Saga found herself face-to-face with a cultist. a hulking figure in a raincoat
cards.translation: 萨加与一个邪教徒打了个照面，那是个穿雨衣的魁梧身影

cards.text: But wake was gone. in custody of the federal bureau of control
cards.translation: 但韦克已经不在了，他被控制在联邦控制局手中

cards.text: Agent Estevez had pulled rank on her. stonewalled her. shut her out of her own case
cards.translation: 埃斯特维兹探员以权压她，处处阻挠，把她挡在自己的案子之外

cards.text: It was manifesting itself around her like the darkness of a mental illness
cards.translation: 它在她周围显现出来，像精神疾病的黑暗

cards.text: She strained her eyes to see through the darkness
cards.translation: 她眯起眼睛，竭力想透过黑暗看清

cards.text: A feedback loop. surging up her arm
cards.translation: 一个反馈回路，顺着她的手臂涌上来

cards.text: Willing it to penetrate the dark matter. burn it away
cards.translation: 她用意念驱使光穿透黑暗物质，把它烧尽

cards.text: Didn't see her under the light. lurched past her
cards.translation: 它没看见灯光下的她，踉踉跄跄地从她身边走过

cards.text: The weapon it carried could crack her skull like a brittle egg. brains leaking out like yolk
cards.translation: 它手里的武器能像捏碎脆蛋一样敲开她的头骨，脑浆会像蛋黄一样流出来

cards.text: They felt oppressive here. too many places to hide
cards.translation: 这些树在这里让人压抑，能藏身的地方太多了

cards.text: The distorted carnival music drifting from the amusement park ahead did not help
cards.translation: 前方游乐园飘来的失真嘉年华音乐让人更加难受

cards.text: What the Koskelas had said about her living in Watery with Logan unsettled her
cards.translation: 科斯凯拉家说她和萝根住在 Watery，这话让她心里不安

cards.text: A noise overhead. saga swiveled to look. a local, a man, on the ridge above her
cards.translation: 头顶传来响动，萨加猛地转身去看：一个本地男人站在上方的山脊上

cards.text: A monster with a hatchet in each hand
cards.translation: 一个双手各握一把短柄斧的怪物

cards.text: A cold dead lump in her hand. her definition of sanity had changed since she arrived in this town
cards.translation: 手里是一块冰冷的死物。自从来到这座小镇，她对神志正常的定义都变了

cards.text: She squinted to read
cards.translation: 她眯起眼才能看清字

cards.text: Saga jabbed the selector on the jukebox
cards.translation: 萨加使劲按了一下点唱机的选曲钮

cards.text: The needle crackled on the vinyl. the song swelled
cards.translation: 唱针在黑胶上噼啪作响，歌声渐起

cards.text: The lamentation of an old man. his heart was broken
cards.translation: 一个老人的哀歌。他的心碎了

cards.text: A tarp thrown over top. drowning everything beneath it
cards.translation: 一块防水篷布罩在上面，把下面的一切都闷住了

cards.text: Scratch stalked through the forest, a terrifying dark presence in the night, more sensed than seen
cards.translation: 斯克拉奇在林中潜行，像夜里一个恐怖的黑暗存在，与其说被看见，不如说被感觉到

cards.text: Darkness boiled in his skull. like a storm cloud crammed into a bottle
cards.translation: 黑暗在他颅内沸腾，像一场被塞进瓶子的风暴云

cards.text: His singular purpose was a sharp, pulsing black hole in his head, waves roaring out of it to whip his flock into a frenzy, filling them with his purpose
cards.translation: 他单一的执念是颅内一个尖锐搏动的黑洞，声浪从中咆哮而出，驱策着他的群从陷入狂热，把他的目的灌满他们全身

cards.text: The taken gibbered and shouted, straining against their invisible leashes. filled with bloodlust. scratch let them go. they launched themselves into the night with violent glee
cards.translation: 被夺者胡言乱语、嘶吼着，绷紧无形的锁链。他们满心嗜血。斯克拉奇放了手，他们便狂喜着扑进夜色

cards.text: He ripped a signpost from the ground, swung it in his hand as if it was made of air
cards.translation: 他把路标从地里拔出来，在手里挥舞，轻得像空气做的

cards.text: Ahead, the music started. it called him on. let the final deerfest commence
cards.translation: 前方音乐响起，召唤他继续前进。让最后一届鹿节开始吧

cards.text: The parautilitarian was already in custody
cards.translation: 那位异能者已经被羁押了

cards.text: Another clatter. behind him. closer this time. he turned, hand on his holster
cards.translation: 又是一声哐当，在他身后，这次更近了。他转过身，手按上枪套

cards.text: Alan wake had ridden this same ferry into town when he arrived. this was his entry into bright falls
cards.translation: 艾伦·韦克当年就是乘同一条渡轮进的镇。这是他进入 bright falls 的入口

cards.text: Tammy felt rain drops on her face. "god, again?" she pulled up her hood
cards.translation: 塔米感到雨点落在脸上。"天哪，又下雨？"她拉起了兜帽

cards.text: He masterminded the cult, his and jaakko's army to fight the horror lurking under the lake, and a plan to keep those feds in their bunker by the lake in the dark
cards.translation: 是他一手策划了邪教，他和亚科的军队用来对抗潜伏在湖底的恐怖存在，还设计把那些联邦探员蒙在湖边地堡的鼓里

cards.text: The koskela brothers sabotaged the FBC's monitoring station and rigged it to alert them when something was brewing at the lake
cards.translation: 科斯凯拉兄弟破坏了控制局的监测站，还暗中做了手脚，每当湖边有什么在酝酿，装置就会给他们报警

cards.text: Children in bright falls all grew up hearing stories about the cult of the tree. feral maniacs living in the woods. satanists chanting "we watch in the night" as they performed blood sacrifices in the forest
cards.translation: bright falls 的孩子们从小听着大树邪教的故事长大：住在林中的野疯子，一面吟诵"我们在黑夜中守望"一面在森林里行血祭的撒旦教徒

cards.text: Ilmo gestured at the files they had stolen from the research station
cards.translation: 伊尔莫朝他们从研究站偷来的文件扬了扬下巴

cards.text: Energized, jaakko chugged a bottle of ahma beer in one go
cards.translation: 亚科来了劲，一口气灌下了一整瓶 ahma 啤酒

cards.text: His palms were clammy
cards.translation: 他的手心又湿又黏

cards.text: The koskela brothers were crouching in the bushes across from the elderwood palace lodge, its lights shining in the night. the crowd murmured the chant back to him
cards.translation: 科斯凯拉兄弟蹲在长老木宫殿旅馆对面的灌木丛里，旅馆的灯光在夜里闪烁。人群低声跟着他念诵咒文

cards.text: Bailey saw a snarling face in the darkness
cards.translation: 贝利在黑暗中看见一张龇牙咆哮的脸

cards.text: As their agent, Barry Wheeler had managed to coax a few hit songs out of them before that
cards.translation: 作为他们的经纪人，巴里·惠勒在那之前好不容易哄出了他们几首热门单曲

cards.text: Wheeler squinted. his migraine flared. booze and drugs. a rock n' roll cliché(/kliˈʃeɪ/;老套)
cards.translation: 惠勒眯起眼，偏头痛又发作了。酒精加毒品，摇滚乐的老一套

cards.text: Diana innovated and jules got funding from the bureaucrats
cards.translation: 黛安娜负责创新，朱尔斯从官僚手里拿到经费

cards.text: Challenging, but not insurmountable. not for them
cards.translation: 有挑战，但并非无法克服。至少对他们来说不是

cards.text: It became trapped, stagnant. went bad
cards.translation: 它被困住了，成了死水，慢慢变质

cards.text: The contrived overlap rebounded on itself
cards.translation: 这次人为造出的异界重叠反噬了自身

cards.text: Cause and effect hopelessly entangled
cards.translation: 因果纠缠得无可解开

cards.text: Red hues ran down his hands. was it scarlet? or cadmium? too vivid to be maroon
cards.translation: 红色调顺着他的手往下淌。是猩红？还是镉红？太鲜亮了，不可能是褐红

cards.text: The strokes were crude, violent
cards.translation: 笔触粗粝而暴烈

cards.text: He slumped down to the floor, smiling at the anger he left smeared across the wall
cards.translation: 他瘫倒在地板上，望着自己涂抹在墙上的愤怒，笑了

cards.text: They could feel an outsider trespassing in their labs
cards.translation: 他们能感觉到有外人在擅自闯入他们的实验室

cards.text: The sheer audacity of this impossible mystery presented to them
cards.translation: 这个不可能的谜团摆在他们面前，狂妄得离谱

cards.text: An overlap of the dark place needed a push from both directions to manifest itself. reality in our world eroded by repeated dark lore tied to a location. and a counterpoint, a work of art, a horror narrative, crafted in the depths of the dark place, connecting to the story on the other side, to reach out through the weakened veil
cards.translation: 黑暗之地的异界重叠需要从两个方向同时推动才能显现：我们世界的现实被与某地绑定的黑暗传说反复侵蚀；同时，一件在黑暗之地深处锻造的艺术品、一个恐怖叙事，作为对应的一极，与另一侧的故事相连，从削薄的帷幕中探伸出来

cards.text: These elements working in conjunction made a trickle that became a torrent. a wormhole. a vortex. and the art, the map, became the nightmare territory where the dark place encroached on our reality, a blanket over it, where they overlapped, causing reality to twist and loop like a bad dream, remolding anything and anyone within its dark horror design
cards.translation: 这些要素共同作用，涓流汇成激流——一条虫洞，一个漩涡。而那件艺术品，那张地图，成了黑暗之地蚕食我们现实的梦魇疆域，像一床被子盖在上面，两界在此重叠，让现实像噩梦般扭曲循环，把它黑暗恐怖设计中的任何人和事物都重塑一遍

cards.text: Standing inside the trailer, at the outskirts of Watery, Saga had seen Wake's fabled clicker for the first time
cards.translation: 站在 Watery 郊外那辆拖车里，萨加第一次见到了韦克那件传说中的开关器

cards.text: Only the most tenacious stubbornly remained
cards.translation: 只有最顽强的家伙还固执地守在这里

cards.text: The koskela brothers doublehandedly warded off the impending darkness with their ventures
cards.translation: 科斯凯拉兄弟凭二人之力，用他们的营生挡住了步步逼近的黑暗
